en: A vintage, yellowed postcard back with German pre‑printed text and a handwritten Spanish address. At the top center it reads "Postkarte" in a Gothic font. On the right is a faded German stamp area and a circular postal cancellation mark that appears to say "BERLIN." The address is written in ink to "gran maestro Pérez Galdós" in large cursive, with "Madrid" prominently written in the center and "Teatro Español" noted as part of the address. Small printed German words for address fields appear along the bottom.
